description: Machine-readable sync brief posted by a music supervisor or agent. Studied from SourceAudio / DISCO / SyncIt brief structures (credited as studied, not endorsed): mood-led search, descriptive scene blurb, tempo range, budget band, deadline. All seeds are SAMPLE-labeled until a real supervisor posts.

budget_band.description: Budget band only — never fee numbers on a public board.

contact_channel.description: How to reach the poster (e.g. public handle, not a private email).

deadline.description: ISO date the brief expires; rotten briefs are removed.

moods.description: Primary search axis — supervisors search by mood first (TAXI 2026 sync blueprint, studied).

scene_use.description: 1-3 sentence descriptive blurb: what scene/moment the music serves (the 'brief as wish list' field).

status.description: sample = seed/example brief, not from a real supervisor. live = real posted brief.

title: Sync Shelf Brief
